prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic pastel pink high-fashion portrait with feathered knit styling against a warm orange seamless background.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman with slicked-back wet-look hair, natural satin skin, pastel turquoise-green eyeshadow, natural pink satin lips, pastel-pink fine-knit top with an opaque lining, fluffy feathered sleeve ends, feathery yarn scarf around shoulders and neckline, and gold sunburst earrings; hands raised in a relaxed guard-like frame near the face without touching it.
prompt.composition_elements: Slightly low-angle portrait, face sharply focused, hands softly out of focus at upper frame edges, warm orange flat seamless background, pastel pink and lavender styling.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused frontal light with very soft shadows, slightly warm editorial grade, minimal retouching.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, realistic knit and feather texture, accurate hands, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic high-fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman with slicked-back wet-look hair, natural satin skin, pastel turquoise-green eyeshadow and natural pink satin lips, pastel-pink fine-knit top with opaque lining, fluffy feathered sleeve ends, feathery yarn scarf around shoulders, gold sunburst earrings, hands raised in a relaxed frame near the face without touching it, warm orange seamless background, soft diffused frontal light, 85mm f/2.8, dreamy serene editorial mood, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, transparent top, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, harsh shadows, busy background, extra fingers, deformed, watermark, logo, text

assets.name: pink feather fashion reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Preserve pastel pink mesh and feathers, scarf, gold earrings, hand framing, orange background and soft light; keep identity and accessory micro-details replaceable.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the reference image. Keep color palette, styling, hands and composition consistent; add only an opaque lining for coverage and use a clearly adult fictional identity.

changes: Clarified adult fictional subject and added opaque lining under the fine-knit top while preserving the pastel feather styling.
